items.text: haan ji
kal tak
accha theek hai

items.context: Please hold for a moment sir can you wait
items.text: thoda wait kr lijiye

items.context: Can you confirm the amount you can pay now
items.text: thik hai ji

items.context: Do you want to speak with our financial hardship team
items.text: ji haan boliye
mera job chala gaya is wajah se payment nahi kar paunga
woh haan main beemar tha is mahine to payment delay ho gaya
meri salary abhi nahi aayi isliye thoda time chahiye
kal ya parson paise bhejne ki koshish karunga ji
maine socha tha Tuesday ko bhej dunga par nahi Wednesday ko
meri kisi family emergency ki wajah se thoda dikkat ho rahi hai
apni financial situation abhi thik nahi hai thoda samay chahiye

items.context: Can you explain why you are not able to pay the instalment this month
items.text: haan ji main job loss ki wajah se payment abhi nahi kar pa raha

items.context: Was there any particular reason for the delay in payment sir
items.text: meri tabiyat theek nahi thi isi wajah se jald payment nahi kar paya

items.context: Can you specify your reason for requesting financial hardship support
items.text: garib parivar ka jimmedar hun is waqt to paisa dena mushkil hai

items.context: When do you think you will be able to make the payment
items.text: main kal tak koshish karunga paisa jama karne ki par confirm nahi hai

items.context: Can you tell us if recent job loss caused this situation
items.text: thodi job dhoond raha tha is reason payment nahi kar saka
main apne previous employer se nikala gaya hu isliye iss mahine payment nahi kar paunga
mere paas abhi medical bills hain jiski wajah se financial condition thodi tight hai
meri salary delay ho gayi hai aur main temporary unpaid leave pe hu isliye mahsus ho raha
main samajhta hu ki payment important hai par meri situation bahut kharab hai is waqt
kal se main ek naye job ke liye interview de raha hu to paisa bhejna mushkil hai
mera dost bhi financial crisis se guzar raha hai to apne parivaar ke sath problems hain
thoda aur samay dena please kyunki job recovery mein kuch din lag jayenge mujhe abhi

items.context: Sir can you tell me if there was any emergency or illness causing the delay
items.text: mai aapse maafi chahta hu par mera accident ho gaya tha us wajah se payment delay hua hai

items.context: Can you explain your current employment status and why payment is delayed
items.text: meri company band ho gayi hai is liye paisa jama karne mein dikkat aa rahi hai mujhe

items.context: What is your plan to clear the outstanding payment sir
items.text: mai kal apne accountant se baat karunga aur turant paise transfer karne ki koshish karunga

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: financial_hardship - explains they cannot pay right now because of job loss, illness or similar
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
